semantic_checklist.source_evidence: Lemma 2.7.7 on PDF pages 22--23 / printed pages 33--34 states product sub-exponentiality and the exact constant-one psi norm inequality, with Definitions 2.5.6 and 2.7.5 as context.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target has the two psi-two finiteness premises and concludes both psi-one finiteness of the pointwise product and the corresponding gauge inequality.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: The complete lemma and its inherited norm definitions are selected.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: X and Y are real random variables on one probability space.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: The target quantifies one measurable Omega, one probability measure mu, and X,Y : Omega -> Real.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: Types and shared probability-space structure match.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: For every pair X,Y, their separate sub-gaussian hypotheses imply conclusions about the same pointwise product.
semantic_checklist.lean_evidence: Universal X,Y binders precede two curried finiteness premises and a conclusion using the same X,Y and mu.
semantic_checklist.reasoning: Quantifier order and object dependence are preserved.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: Both variables are sub-gaussian; independence, centering, and symmetry are not assumed.

semantic_checklist.reasoning: Gauge finiteness encodes sub-gaussian class membership and no extra side condition is added.

semantic_checklist.source_evidence: The norm conclusion is <= with exact constant 1.
